Her nervous system was also adapted to her flexibility so that she did not experience pain or overload from her movements.  She always felt good and comfortable in her body. She does this most of the time at home.  If she does not walk on her hands, then she tries to walk on bent toes, and almost never walks at home just on a full foot.  She also loves and tries to use her legs instead of her arms.  She loves her feet so much that from time to time she can touch her toe to various parts of her head or put her whole foot on her head, and sometimes kiss her feet.  She is tough enough to walk a kilometer on her hands and hardly get tired of it.  She also knows how to do push-ups in a triple fold, without getting tired.  She is 18 years old.  She is ambidexter.  She lives alone. Her parents send her money and she doesn't work yet.
